data.reason: Fifth review, one high finding and two low. J1: a failed deterministic check is appended to the same reasons list as the three depth rules, and the whole Jev request is skipped when that list is non-empty, so criterion_evidenced is never asked on exactly the tickets pass one already found something wrong with. The solution record says the opposite of what was built, that a failure forces full depth and is carried in the record while only Jev's unevidenced criterion returns the ticket. All five triages on this branch carry jev.asked false and criteria_answers empty because slice_files fails, so pass two has never run once, and every one records excluded_share 0.0, which in kpi.json is indistinguishable from a narrowing that would have saved nothing and is the figure SEEN-109 divides on. J2: tests_added is listed as settled while it proves only that some path matching the test regex is in the diff, which is H2 and H3 in a third check. J3: procedure_paths and always_read read the ticket file from record 1, which SEEN-101 allows to go stale on a rename, while cli._ticket_text already resolves it by id.
